responsibility: Defines the master list of gcov counter kinds through DEF_GCOV_COUNTER macro expansion. The file assigns each supported counter’s enum name, on-disk/display name, and merge-function class for arc counts and value-profiling histograms such as interval, pow2, top-N, indirect-call, average, IOR, and time profiling. It serves as the single source used by headers, compiler code, and gcov tools to generate synchronized counter enums, names, tags, and merge tables.
